topic.title: Making an Oxygen Project a Git Repository

body.p: When showing the Git Staging side-view after opening an project that is not already a Git repository, if the Ask user to create new repository option is enabled in preferences, offers the possibility to make that project a local Git repository. This is useful for newly created projects, for example.

In the Ellipsis (three vertical dots) menu from the Git Staging side-view and in the Git main menu, there is also a Create repository in project action that can be used to create a Git repository in the project folder.

After creating the local repository, you will need to bind it to a remote repository. You will be asked to specify the URL of the corresponding remote repository on your first attempt to push or pull changes.
